what_happened: Found an existing in-repo precedent (record-version-patterns.sh's strip_exempt_regions, a one-pass awk line-blanking filter between markers) that directly validated the heredoc-stripping design (Option 1) and gave a concrete implementation shape, without needing any external research.

This plan dispatch reproduced the defect it plans to fix: the plan file's prose quotes all three legs of the hook's conjunction, so authoring it via a Bash heredoc would have been refused by the deployed validate-bounded-waiter.sh. Authored with the Write tool instead, and carried the same constraint forward as an explicit step note on Phases 1 and 2 plus a Risks row. Direct confirming evidence that the false-positive surface recurs on exactly the content class that documents the rule.
